messages:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — reactivation nurture for trial users who called hosted API >=3x but didn't convert. idea: 3-email drip over 10 days + invite to a focused benchmark webinar on day 4. want to align segmentation + subject lines. pinging growth + events. TL;DR: webinar as mid-drip hook.

Maria Gomez: love it. segment by usage pattern: 'explorers' (<=10 requests, high prompt variety), 'integrators' (consistent endpoints, >10 reqs), 'cost-conscious' (long contexts, heavy tokens).

Jordan Lee: Subject line ideas:
- "How teams cut inference cost 3x — live demo"
- "Benchmark: latency <20ms for common prompts"
- "Your Redwood usage + tips to save on tokens"
I'll A/B test 1 vs 2 vs 3.

Samir Patel: cadence proposal:
- Day 0: Welcome + quick wins (subject 3)
- Day 3: Deep dive + benchmark invite (subject 1)
- Day 6: Case study + CTA (subject 2)
- Day 10: Last-chance webinar reminder + offer
Let's not send more than 1 email every 72 hours per user.

Lina Park: copy microtests — short snippets:
- Welcome: "You started building with Redwood — here's 3 tweaks to reduce latency now."
- Webinar invite: "See our live run of the latest benchmark + Q&A"
- Case study: include quote + metric: "reduced per-token cost by 42%"
Include UTM: `?utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=trial_reactivate_apr&utm_medium=email`

Marketing Bot: Added webinar event to calendar: 2026-04-08 11:00 UTC. Automation play created: `campaign/reactivate-trials-2026`.

Alex Chen: ok next steps — Jordan to wire A/B variants and sample sends in Mailer, Maria to provide cohort lists by EOD, Lina to draft copy and snippets, Samir to finalize schedule and overflow suppression rules. I'll own webinar landing + benchmark post.

Maria Gomez: note — exclude users who have active enterprise trials or are in Dedicated onboarding.

Jordan Lee: will push two variants to the test list by 1705230000-1705233600 window.

Lina Park: added tracking tags and proposed heatmap events for opens and CTA clicks.

Samir Patel: question — do we want a soft discount in the last email or just a trial extension?

Alex Chen: prefer trial extension first. reserve discounts for sales-assisted only.

Maria Gomez: :thumbsup:

Jordan Lee: ok launching A/B tomorrow morning. I'll post send report in this thread after first wave.

Marketing Bot: Reminder scheduled: send campaign preview to #marketing at 2026-03-27 09:00 UTC.

Alex Chen: thanks team — syncing with ops on deliverability tomorrow. posting benchmark draft to docs shortly.
